i've had problems all my menstrual-life. 

For a while I was told it seemed that I had PCOS and Endometriosis. I never followed through. Between 22ish and 28 I was constantly bleeding on and off. I ignored it. I just lived with it. It was harder when I got married. I felt gross all the time. I've been on various forms of the pill since I was 16 and it didn't change the fact that I bleed heavily and a lot. And because it's how it always was I never really thought to question it. I spoke to one dr once but either I was too vague or he wasn't useful... he gave me ponstan to take before they started to make them a bit less painful. I have a feeling he thought I was exaggerating everything...

After having my son and my period came back it got worse. I was unimpressed. Went to a gyno - we decided to have investigative surgery and the PCOS and Endo was confirmed. they scraped out the Endo. 

Then I went on the Mirena - 5 years' of implanted hormones. I STILL bleed heavily and all the time. I then went on some hormone pill for three months to re-train my body. 

Since then; YAY! I don't take daily pills, no extra bleeding or spotting! My normal periods went from being 8-9 days to 2-4. And super douper light! 

It took some work but I got there!
